Hi Alice  looping in from Security/Platform team to confirm specifics below. Short answers up-front, full notes after.

1) Training / model improvement: We confirm that Acme Finance data will NOT be used to train or improve Redwood public or private model weights unless Acme provides explicit, written consent. We will flag the account-level opt-out in our tenant metadata and ensure it is enforced across our ingestion pipeline.

2) Retention & logging: Standard request/response logs for hosted API customers are retained by default for 90 days for debugging and outage investigation. For customers requiring shorter retention or on-demand purge, we support configurable retention policies and manual purge requests via our support ticketing process. We can also provide an SLA for log purge timelines for enterprise contracts.

3) PII handling: Redwood offers an optional pre-ingest PII redaction pipeline (token-level hashing and entity redaction) that can be enabled per-tenant. We recommend enabling it for anything with regulated identifiers. Customers may also implement client-side redaction prior to sending.

Attached is a short template confirming opt-out that Stephanie can sign and send back (opt-out-confirmation-template.pdf). We'll also attach the completed questionnaire (acme_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx) after minor edits.

Let me know if you want a short technical call to walk through redaction and retention controls.

-Markus
Markus Klein\Solutions Architect\Redwood Inference
